description: ryukoku-writing: active only for a folder that carries .ryukoku/config.yml (found from the target path, the session folder or one or two levels below it). Manuscript writes follow the course AI policy (allowed: allowed and recorded as provenance per paragraph; limited/unknown: ask; prohibited: deny; a recognised shell write form is denied, any other command that may write asks). Deny AI writes to .ryukoku/ (records, provenance, settings), the tools, CI and Git hooks, the export settings (pandoc/), the student's questions and thinking log, with every tool including Bash; detect changes to protected files made during AI tool calls (msguard) and log them in the chained AI-use log; run the mechanical verification after a manuscript write; stop prompts that contain personal data; add the course policy and the drafting rules to writing requests; log searches automatically.
